## Checklist

Details for each item are in [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/jaxparrow07/liquidglass-kde-widgets/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md).

- [ ] Tested on a real desktop with `./install.sh`, not only in `plasmoidviewer`
- [ ] Anything visual follows the [Visual review criteria](https://github.com/jaxparrow07/liquidglass-kde-widgets/blob/master/DESIGN.md#visual-review-criteria), with screenshots in Glass and Solid, Dark and Light
- [ ] New or changed text uses `i18n()`, and I ran `./translate/merge.sh`
- [ ] Shared files from `1-common/` are still symlinked, not copied
- [ ] One focused change (unrelated fixes go in separate pull requests)
